sections.description: Provides AI-assisted content opportunity analysis, human approval workflows, draft generation, and permanent Content management for the Global 360 platform.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin in /wp-content/plugins/360-ai/.
  2. Activate 360 AI and configure a supported provider.
sections.changelog:
0.4.4

  • Add the standard 360 GitHub updater for future WordPress Admin updates.
  • Preserve strict package ownership and normalize GitHub branch ZIPs to the canonical plugin directory.

0.4.3

  • Add bounded private Anthropic transport diagnostics and distinguish transport, HTTP, validation, and historical failures.

0.4.2

  • Make opportunity analysis resilient by selecting the first five valid recommendations from eight ordered candidates.
